summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new FeGrro features: public employee hours links, Polish holidays, month navigation, and hour entry tooltips. All 17/18 backend tests passed (1 minor failure for legacy data). All frontend features verified working correctly.

minor.issue: Legacy hour entries (created before feature) don't have created_by_name field - expected behavior for old data

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/holidays?year=2026 returns correct Polish holidays
Backend: Holidays include fixed dates (Jan 1, Jan 6, May 1, May 3, Aug 15, Nov 1, Nov 11, Dec 25, Dec 26)
Backend: Easter Monday 2026 calculated correctly (April 6)
Backend: Corpus Christi 2026 calculated correctly (June 4)
Backend: Pentecost 2026 calculated correctly (May 24)
Backend: Holidays returned in sorted order
Backend: GET /api/public/hours/{token} works without authentication
Backend: Public hours returns employee_name, entries, assignments, site_names
Backend: Invalid token returns 404
Backend: POST /api/employees/generate-all-links requires admin auth
Backend: Generate-all-links returns employee_id, full_name, phone_number, token
Backend: Generated tokens work with public hours endpoint
Backend: Generate-all-links is idempotent (same tokens on repeated calls)
Backend: Admin login works with admin@fegrro.pl / Admin123!
Frontend: Hours table has month navigation arrows (< >) working
Frontend: January 2026 shows red borders on Jan 1 (Nowy Rok) and Jan 6 (Trzech Króli)
Frontend: April 2026 shows red border on April 6 (Poniedziałek Wielkanocny)
Frontend: Weekend days have brown borders, holidays have RED borders
Frontend: Legend shows 'Święto ustawowe' entry with red border square
Frontend: 'Linki pracowników' button in header generates links for all employees
Frontend: Links modal shows employee name, phone, unique URL, and copy button
Frontend: Public hours page at /hours/{token} works WITHOUT authentication
Frontend: Public page shows employee name with FeGrro logo
Frontend: Public page shows monthly total and per-site breakdown
Frontend: Public page has month navigation (< >)
Frontend: Public page marks weekends and holidays correctly
Frontend: Hovering over cell with hours shows tooltip with 'Wpisał: [name]' and timestamp

success_rate.backend: 94% (17/18 tests passed - 1 minor failure for legacy data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features implemented and working: 1) Polish holidays endpoint calculates Easter-based holidays using Anonymous Gregorian algorithm. 2) Public employee hours page at /hours/{token} shows mobile-friendly list with month navigation, site breakdown, and holiday markers. 3) Admin can generate links via 'Linki pracowników' button - modal shows all employees with copy buttons. 4) Hour entries track created_by_name and updated_by_name - shown in tooltip on hover. 5) Month navigation with ChevronLeft/ChevronRight buttons. 6) Holidays have red borders (#DC2626), weekends have brown borders (#6B4444).

polish_holidays.notes: Returns fixed holidays + Easter-based (Easter Monday, Corpus Christi, Pentecost)

public_hours_link.notes: No auth required, shows employee hours with month navigation and site breakdown

generate_links.notes: Admin-only, generates unique tokens stored in DB, idempotent

hour_entry_tooltip.notes: Shows 'Wpisał: [name]' and timestamp on hover over cells with hours

month_navigation.notes: ChevronLeft/ChevronRight buttons in hours table and public page

holiday_styling.notes: Red borders (#DC2626) for holidays, brown borders (#6B4444) for weekends
